mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (title, content, type, target_role, status, publisher, publish_time, create_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{targetRole}, #{status}, #{publisher}, #{publishTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, type, target_role, is_top, status, publisher, publish_time, create_time FROM notice WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY is_top DESC, publish_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice WHERE status = 1
